faq_heading: College Park houses: your questions answered

blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for houses in College Park. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

College Park, Port Moody: 11 houses listed at the end of October 2026 and 3 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 27%, which the reports’ scale reads as a sellers’ market. By listings that is number 6 of 11 Port Moody communities for houses.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Port Moody total for houses that month.

blocks.text: Listings of houses in College Park fell from 12 in June to 11 in October (−8.3%), and 10 sold across the 5 months. In October the community held 8.0% of Port Moody’s 138 houses listed.
Houses or condos and townhomes in College Park?
College Park also had 14 condos and townhomes listed and 2 sold in October, against 11 houses listed. The College Park condos and townhomes page has those figures.

blocks.text: College Park home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

16 houses sold in College Park with a median price of $1,640,850 (the middle half sold between $1,353,750 and $1,858,750), taking a median of 28 days to sell at 96.9% of the last list price; 19% sold above list. They had a median $600 per square foot, a median year built of 1973 and a median lot of 7,594 square feet.

blocks.source: Source: Paragon, the MLS® system used by Jared’s office, closed sales from November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026. Pending sales are not counted. Median means the middle price, so half sold for more and half for less. Sold vs list is the sale price as a percentage of the last list price. A figure is shown only where at least 5 homes sold, and a row is shown only with 5 or more sales; with fewer, one sale would be the whole figure.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in College Park?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 11 houses listed in College Park. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is College Park a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses in College Park had a sales ratio of 27%, which the reports’ scale reads as a sellers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in College Park from June to October 2026?
faq.a: 10 houses sold in College Park over those 5 months, out of 64 in all of Port Moody.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in College Park?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.

faq.q: What did houses in College Park sell for?
faq.a: 16 houses sold in College Park between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,640,850.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in College Park?
faq.a: The median was 28 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 96.9% of the last list price (19% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
